investigation_notes.Alert Name: Trend Micro: Possible Data Encrypted for Impact
investigation_notes.Description: Ransomware indicators detected on host HOST-01, associated with the Locky ransomware family, including a ransomware file and ransom note with a heuristic suggesting encryption for impact. The involved file appears under the Financials directory with a SHA-256 of c17fe4a49e12034f44ad74793d520d17a1c6585bec5f3f03b5558da37a0b4617 and has been quarantined, along with ransom note detection. Given the ransomware context and encryption risk, this is a high-priority incident requiring immediate verification of containment and recovery readiness, even though remediation actions show quarantine.
